lines.text: What if I told you that you could start an online business using AI, even if you have absolutely no coding or design experience?
And one of the tools that can help you do it is called Claude.
Claude can help you create websites, build simple applications, design digital products, write marketing content, and automate everyday business tasks.
And people are already paying for these services.
Let's say you want to make money building websites.
Find small businesses that don't have a website or have an outdated one.
Use Claude to help you design and build a professional website.
Once it's ready, approach the business and offer to create a website that helps them attract more customers.
You could charge $300, $500, or even more depending on the complexity of the project and the value you provide.
You can also sell digital products, create business tools, build AI chatbots, or offer content creation services.
You don't need to do everything yourself. Claude can help you produce the work much faster.
It's using AI to solve problems people are already willing to pay for.
Want to learn how to do it?
COMMENT "CLAUDE" TO RECEIVE THE TUTORIAL IN YOUR DMs!
